svg.title: jevify fill turns a description of a commit into the real commit, and prints the git command it resolved
svg.desc: The command git log --oneline -30 piped into jevify fill --field 1 --dry-run -- git show --stat --format=%s, with the marker @{-:made route abstain when two commands are too close}, is typed. The 30 commits of the listing scroll by. jevify judges the marker's description against every line, takes column 1 of the winner as the handle, and keeps commit 317cbf7, "fix: route abstains when two commands are too close", with probability 0.99; the next best line scores 0.00 and "none of them" 0.01. The dry run prints git show --stat --format=%s 317cbf7 instead of running it. Output of jevify 0.9.3 on Jev 1.13.0, keyless backend, 2026-09-22.

g.text: $ git log --oneline -30 | jevify fill --field 1 --dry-run -- git show \
--stat --format=%s '@{-:made route abstain when two commands are too close}'
